# Supplemental third-party notices

`react-remove-scroll-bar` 2.3.8 declares MIT in its npm package but omits the
license file from that tarball. The accompanying license is the upstream
repository's published text, retrieved 2026-11-08:

- Repository: https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar
- License blob: `7c08c3990396ecefd90f99ff5d9a34f26f5b5616`
- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/master/LICENSE

The package's npm `gitHead` could not be resolved in that repository, so this is
identified as the upstream notice rather than claimed to be a version-tag match.
All other bundled dependency notices are extracted from installed lockfile-pinned
packages. These notices do not select a license for Daydream itself.
